name: pi-agent-notify
description: Script → agent direct notification channel for pi: external scripts write JSON events to a trigger dir, the extension batches/dedups and injects them into the active agent session as user messages. Identity-aware: subagents with PI_SUBAGENT_TASK_ID listen on their own taskId subdirectory for directed wake-ups.

scripts.check: esbuild extensions/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:@earendil-works/* --outfile=.test-build/index.mjs && node tests/notification_wait.test.mjs .test-build/index.mjs && node tests/legacy_main_compat.test.mjs .test-build/index.mjs && node tests/notify_subagent_tool.test.mjs .test-build/index.mjs && node tests/dotfile_inbox.test.mjs .test-build/index.mjs && node tests/main_restart.test.mjs .test-build/index.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_sender.py'
